title: « Effect of sedative and anxiolytic sedation on children experience after general anesthesia » PEDIA_prem study.
official: « Effect of sedative and anxiolytic sedation on children experience after general anesthesia » PEDIA_prem study.
summary: Main objective: The aim of this prospective randomized clinical trial is to assess the impact of pharmacologic premedication on perioperative children experience.
conditions: General anesthesia and sedative and anxiolytic sedation

interventions.name: DEXMEDETOMIDINE EVER PHARMA 100 microgrammes/mL, solution à diluer pour perfusion
MIDAZOLAM VIATRIS 5 mg/ml, solution injectable ou rectale

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Children older than 7 years old and younger than 18 years old
2. Subject to undergo surgery under general anesthesia
3. Subject able to complete a self-questionnaire
4. Subject requiring intervention under general anesthesia
Exclusion criteria:
1. Subject suffering from anxiety disorders
2. Subject who is not affiliated with or benefiting from a social security plan
3. Subject suffering from cognitive disorders
4. Subject suffering from chronic pain
5. Subject with ADD (Attention Deficit Disorder) with or without hyperactivity; with or without treatment
6. Subjects suffering from mental retardation
7. Subjects receiving psychotropic treatment
8. Subjects whose ability to complete a self-administered questionnaire may be impaired by the intervention
9. Subject with a contraindication to midazolam or to dexmedetomidine
10. Subjects requiring peri-operative alpha agonist
11. Subject who has already participated in the pediaPREM study
12. Subject who needs to undergo an emergency procedure
13. Subjects who need preoperative hypnosis
14. Subject who needs general anesthesia for diagnostic purposes (biopsy, etc...)
15. Subjects who need a neurosurgical intervention or had a surgical intervention in the month preceding inclusion.
16. Subject who will have an iterative surgical intervention within 15 days (removal of material, burns, etc.)
17. Subjects who are scheduled for surgery as part of oncology management
18. Pregnant or breastfeeding woman
19. Subject whose parent has not signed a written informed consent
